div.head: Iud Dei VIII 1
div.ab: Ic eow halsie þurh ðonne Fæder 7 þone Sunu 7 þone Halgan gast 7 þurh heowerne cristendóm, þe ge underfengon, 7 þurh þa halgan rode, þe Crist on ðrowode, 7 þurh þa halgan godspel 7 ða reliquias, þe on ðisse cyrcan syndon,

I adjure you by the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, and by the Christianity which you have received, and by the holy Cross on which Christ suffered, and by the holy Gospels and the relics which are in this church,

Ich beschwöre euch bei dem Vater und dem Sohne und dem Heiligen Geiste und bei eurem Christenthum, welches ihr empfangen habt, und bei dem heiligen Kreuze, an welchem Christus gelitten hat, und bei den heiligen Evangelien und den Reliquien, welche in dieser Kirche sind,

I adjure you by the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, and by your Christianity which you have received, and by the holy cross on which Christ suffered, and by the holy gospels and the relics which are in this church,
div.note: Chapter 1 is translated word for word from the Latin ordo printed by Zeumer (Formulae p. 697, no. 5), Liebermann notes.
